raw_segments.text: Toise a contention in public which may, without contradictions, suffer the report.
It was much like an argument that fell out last night, where each of us fell in praise
of our country mistresses, this gentleman at that time vouching, and upon warrant of
bloody affirmation, his to be more fair, virtuous, wise, chaste, constant, qualified, and less
attemptable than any the rarest of our ladies in France.
